title: Skill ledger
description: Single source of truth shared by pipeline 1 (skill-finder) and pipeline 2 (Trellis fit). Pipeline 1 owns the 'security' block. Pipeline 2 owns the 'fit' block. Neither writes the other's block.

entries.description: Keyed by entry id: a stable slug derived from the source URL.

origin.description: manual = you handed it to the app; the rest are crawled.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit if pinned.

content_hash.description: sha256 over the skill's file tree. Changes here invalidate both security and fit blocks.

state.description: discovered -> (awaiting_fit | quarantined). awaiting_fit -> (fit_evaluated | adopted | rejected) via pipeline 2. 'awaiting_fit' is the pipeline 1 -> pipeline 2 handoff: pipeline 1 has written the security block (recommendation + raw completeness signals) and does NOT pre-judge fitness; pipeline 2 routes from those signals. 'quarantined' (DO_NOT_INSTALL) is terminal and never handed over. (v1 'cleared'/'scanned' both migrate to 'awaiting_fit'.)

scan_mode.description: A low score from a static-only scan is not the same as a clean full scan. Record which one produced this verdict.

llm_model.description: Model slug behind the LLM leg (from scan metadata.inference_usage); null for a static-only scan. Verdicts from different models are not comparable.

llm_provider.description: Provider namespace reported by SkillSpector (e.g. 'openai' for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint). The actual serving backend behind an OpenRouter model is NOT observable through SkillSpector's JSON.

llm_seed.description: SKILLSPECTOR_SEED in effect for the scan. With no pinned backend, reproducibility of an LLM verdict rests on this plus llm_temperature.

llm_requested.description: Pipeline 1 ran (or tried to run) the LLM leg for this scan.

llm_ran.description: The LLM leg produced a verdict (scan_mode == 'static+llm'). false under --no-llm or on provider failure.

llm_attempts.description: Whole-scan LLM invocations pipeline 1 made this run (1 = no retry needed; up to LLM_RETRY_ATTEMPTS).

llm_last_error.description: Failure reason from the final LLM attempt, or null if the LLM leg succeeded / was not run.

llm_attempt_log.description: One entry per whole-scan LLM attempt: when it ran and how it failed (null error = that attempt succeeded).

blind_spot_kind.description: Set only when classify_incompleteness == blind_spot. 'structural' = the scanner cannot finish reading this skill and will fail identically every run (settled). 'provider_unavailable' = only the LLM leg failed and the static scan is benign/clean; needs_rescan() retries it next run. 'provider_persistent' = provider_unavailable that has recurred for LLM_PERSISTENT_FAILURE_RUNS consecutive runs; treated as settled (payload too large for the model), no longer retried.

consecutive_provider_failures.description: Count of consecutive runs the LLM leg came back provider_unavailable. Reset by any other outcome. Reaches LLM_PERSISTENT_FAILURE_RUNS -> blind_spot_kind becomes 'provider_persistent'.

is_complete.description: SkillSpector's analysis_completeness.is_complete. Recorded raw; pipeline 2 classifies whether an incomplete scan is a real blind spot.

degraded_analyzers.description: Analyzer ids that did not reach 'completed'. Count and membership both matter to pipeline 2's blind-spot classification.

fit.description: Written only by pipeline 2. Absent until the entry reaches state 'awaiting_fit'.

target.description: What it was evaluated as useful FOR, e.g. 'trellis@2.0.0'.

relevance.description: Gate A. Cheap filter against the capability manifest.

redundancy.description: Gate B. Overlap against skills already installed.

note.description: Set when the signal was absent (e.g. no embeddings provider), explaining why the verdict is not 'novel'.

validation.description: Gate C. SkillEvaluator tier 1 hygiene, hard failures only.

passed.description: False only when a hard (structural/unsafe) validator failed.

provenance_flags.description: Gate C soft flags: publication-readiness gaps (no LICENSE, no author, missing sections, low quality score, lint advisories). Never reject; decide() uses them to cap the verdict at 'trial'.

scan_flags.description: Pipeline 2's read of the security block's completeness signals: e.g. 'scan incomplete (blind_spot): LLM leg did not complete'. Same mechanism as provenance_flags -- never rejects, caps the verdict at 'trial'. Empty when the scan was complete.

live_eval.description: Gate D. Tier 3 A/B: agent runs the task set with and without the skill.

deltas.description: with_skill minus without_skill, per dimension. Positive is better.

verdict.description: deferred = passed the cheap gates but the expensive gate has not run yet.
